title: At the Doctor's / Ee ka alkajiro
bridge: Faroodka Soomaaliga, inoo sheegay qalad u qallafsan waxaynu u isticmaalaa 'me duele' + qaybta jidhka (me duele la cabeza). Faroodka Ingiriiska, qalabka wuxuu ka buuxda: 'I have' + 'a headache' (tengo un dolor de cabeza). Waxaana mid ka mid ah maxaa yeelay 'I hurt my head' ma ayuu ku qallajin la'aan u ah. Haddana, faroodka Ingiriiska, 'hurt' wuxuu u adeegaa fiil: 'My head hurts' (mi cabeza duele). Inoo darsan lahaa 'have' la jirka sustantivos qalad iyo 'hurt' la jirka cagaaran waxay noqon doontaa midaan inay ku noqoto faroodka Ingiriiska.
rule: Inoo sheegay calaamadooyinka iyo macruuftooyinka faroodka Ingiriiska, waxaynu isticmaalaa: 1) 'I have' + sustantivo (a headache, a cold, a fever, a cough, a sore throat, a stomachache, etc.) inoo sheegay inaad qalad u qallafsantahay. 2) 'My [qaybta jidhka] hurts' ama 'My [qaybta jidhka] is sore' inoo sheegay qalad u qallafsanta qaybta jidhka. 3) 'I feel' + adjective (sick, dizzy, tired, etc.) inoo sheegay xaalad ku jira. Su'aalooyinka iyo jawabooyinka qaawana ah, waxaynu isticmaalaa 'do/does' (Do you have...? Yes, I do. No, I don't). Inoo sheegay talooyinka, waxaynu isticmaalaa 'should' / 'shouldn't' (You should rest, You shouldn't eat spicy food). Xusuuso in 'hurt' wuxuu yahay fiil aan xaalad ku jirin: hurt - hurt - hurt. 'Me duele' ma isticmaalina; cagaaran wuxuu u jeeda: 'My head hurts' (no 'I hurt my head' haddii aan jirin dhibaato). Waxaa la yaqaan 'I've got' sidii qalab u ah 'I have got' (I've got a cold). Qalabka rasmi ah, waxaa lagu isticmaalayaa 'I have a cold'.

concept_examples.text: I have a headache and a sore throat.
concept_examples.translation: Anigu waan qalad bahal ah iyo qalad gurguurta.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈhɛdeɪk ənd ə sɔːr θroʊt/

concept_examples.text: My stomach hurts after eating.
concept_examples.translation: Qaladii baa qabtay dhexdooda cunto.

concept_examples.text: Do you have a fever?
concept_examples.translation: Ma qaban tahay beer?

concept_examples.text: You should drink a lot of water.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad cabbito biyo badan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd drɪŋk ə lɒt əv ˈwɔːtər/

common_error.explanation: Khalaadka waxay ka soo baxay tarjumadda adag 'me duele la cabeza' sidii 'I hurt my head'. Laakiin 'hurt' sidii fiil wuxuu u qallafsan yahay cadaadisan (me lastimé la cabeza). Inoo sheegay qalad ku jira, waxaa lagu isticmaalayaa 'have a headache' ama 'my head hurts'. Xusuuso: 'hurt' sidii fiil aan cagaaran lahayn (aan cagaaran lahayn) wuxuu u sheegaa qaladka, laakiin cagaaran wuxuu u ah qaybta jidhka (my head hurts). Hubi inaad isticmaashid 'have' + sustantivo inoo sheegay macruuftooyinka ku jira.

examples.original: I have a cold.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'have' + macruufto ama calaamado. Ha odhan 'I am cold' inoo sheegay jilco, waxaas wuxuu u qallafsan yahay inaad qabashid qabow.

examples.original: I have a cough and a runny nose.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kɒf ænd ə ˈrʌni noʊz/
examples.translation: Anigu waan qaban soojeedo iyo mukh.
examples.note: Tartan calaamadooyinka la jirka 'and' waa mid ku jira: soojeedo and mukh. Fiiri 'mukh' (mukh).)

examples.original: I feel dizzy.
examples.note: 'Feel' + adjective inoo sheegay xaalad jidhka. Faroodka Soomaaliga waxaynu isticmaalaa 'anigu waan qaban', laakiin faroodka Ingiriiska ma isticmaalina 'I feel me'.

examples.original: Take this medicine twice a day.
examples.note: Fiilka 'take' waa lagu isticmaalayaa dawaad, 'drink' (cabbi). 'Laba jeer malintii' wuxuu u qallafsan yahay laba jeer malintii.

examples.original: You should rest in bed.
examples.translation: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad furto goobta.
examples.note: Inoo sheegay talooyin, 'should' + fiilka aan xaalad ku jirin. Waa u adag 'must' (waajib).)

examples.original: I need to make an appointment.
examples.translation: Waxaan u baahan tahay inaan sameeyo talada.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'make an appointment' inoo sheegay talada alkajiro. 'Need to' + fiil wuxuu u sheegaa u baahan yahay.

examples.original: My back hurts a lot.
examples.note: 'A lot' dhexdooda ama dambe fiilka. Ha odhan 'my back hurts much' aan 'a' lahayn.

examples.original: I have a sharp pain in my chest.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ʃɑːrp peɪn ɪn maɪ tʃɛst/
examples.translation: Anigu waan qaban qalad adag dhexdooda qasabta.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'sharp' inoo sheegay qalad adag iyo 'dull' inoo sheegay qalad adag. Sheeg meeshii la jirka 'in my + qaybta jidhka'.

examples.original: My knee is swollen and red.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'is' + adjective inoo sheegay xaalad. Xusuuso in 'swollen' waa adjective aan xaalad ku jirin.

title: Booking Accommodation / Qaybta ku celcelis
bridge: Faroodka Soomaaliga waxaan ku isticmaamo fiilka 'ku celcelis' si toos ah ('waxaan ku celcelin qol'), laakiin Af-Ingiriisii waxaa la isticmaalaa 'would like' + 'to book' in lagu noqoto adag. Waxaad samatabbixinta u dhaqmi kartaa: Faroodka Soomaaliga waxaan leenay 'qol labaad' ilaa adagka soo socda, laakiin Af-Ingiriisii adaggu wuxuu u horreysaa ('double room'). Suxul, Af-Ingiriisii waxaan isticmaamo 'for' inaanu u sheego muddadda ('for two nights'), inta Soomaaliga waxaan leenay 'laba habeen'.
rule: Inaad qaybta ku celceliso Af-Ingiriisii ku dhago darajadda A2, isticmaalo xukummo oo la mid yahay: 'I would like to book...' (Waxaan jeclaan inaan ku celcelin...), 'I'd like to make a reservation' (Waxaan jeclaan inaan sameeyo celcelis). Isticmaali fiilka mudharacad inaad si taar ka bixiso macluumaad shakhsi: 'Magacay waa...'. Muddadda, isticmaali 'on' maalin ('on Monday') iyo 'for' muddadda ('for three nights'). Inaad weydii doonista, isticmaali 'Do you have...?' (Ma haysaan...?) ama 'Is there...?' (Miyaanu jira...?). Qooladyada qolka ku yaal: 'single room' (qol fardi), 'double room' (qol labaad), 'twin room' (qol laba qol). Xusuuso in Af-Ingiriisii tijaabka wuxuu u horreysaa adaggii + magaca. Inaad soo bandhigto adeegyada, isticmaali 'with' (la): 'with a view' (la fiid), 'with breakfast' (la quraac).

concept_examples.text: I would like to book a double room for two nights.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan inaan ku celcelin qol labaad laba habeen.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː tuː naɪts/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any rooms available for this weekend?
concept_examples.translation: Ma haysaan qolal doonaya inay ku noqotaan danbalo?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni ruːmz əˈveɪləbəl fɔː ðɪs ˌwiːkˈɛnd/

concept_examples.text: I'd like a room with a sea view, please.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan inaan hel qol la fiid badda, fadlan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk ə ruːm wɪð ə siː vjuː pliːz/

concept_examples.text: How much does it cost per night?
concept_examples.translation: Waa maxay qiimihii habeenka?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ɪt kɒst pɜː naɪt/

common_error.wrong: I want reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct: I would like to reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct_alt: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
common_error.explanation: Faroodka Soomaaliga waxaan leenay 'waxaan jeclaan inaan ku celcelin' fiilka 'jeclaan', laakiin Af-Ingiriisii 'want' waa si adag u leh iyo si aan u adagayn. Waxa fiican inaad isticmaashid 'would like' (waxaan jeclaan). Suxul, Af-Ingiriisii markaa soo socda 'would like' waxaad isticmaashaa 'to' + fiilka infinitive: 'I would like to reserve'. Ha addin 'I want reserve' (aan 'to' ahayn). Waxaad samatabbixinta u isticmaali kartaa 'book' (ku celcelis) oo ah mid aan u isticmaalo hotalkiisa.

examples.original: Do you have a single room available?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ruːm əˈveɪləbəl/
examples.note: Isticmaali 'Do you have...?' inaad weydii doonista. 'Available' wuxuu soo socda magaca.

examples.original: Is there a room for tonight?
examples.note: Isticmaali 'Is there...?' inaad weydii haddii ay jirto.

examples.original: Are there any free rooms on Friday?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈɛni friː ruːmz ɒn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Miyaanu jirta qolal xoqal ah Jimcaha?
examples.note: Inaad isticmaashid tirako, isticmaali 'Are there any...?'. Xusuuso 'on' maalmaha toddobaadka.

examples.original: I'm sorry, we're fully booked.
examples.translation: Waan ka xumahay, waxaan ku celcelinnaa.
examples.note: Tusaale aad u isticmaalay inaad sheegtid inaan qolal jirin. 'Fully booked' wuxuu yahay buuxiyey/ku celceliyey.

examples.original: I'd like to book a double room for three nights.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː θriː naɪts/
examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan inaan ku celcelin qol labaad saddex habeen.
examples.note: Isticmaali 'I'd like' (qalbiyeya 'would like') inaad noqoto rasmi iyo adag.

examples.original: Can I reserve a room with a balcony?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɪˈzɜːv ə ruːm wɪð ə ˈbælkəni/
examples.translation: Ma aan ku celcelin karo qol la balaas?
examples.note: Isticmaali 'Can I...?' inaad weydii idinku. 'With' waa in la isticmaalo si ay u soo bandhigto xaalad.

examples.original: My name is Ana García. I have a reservation.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈɑːnə ɡɑːrˈsiːə aɪ hæv ə ˌrezəˈveɪʃən/
examples.translation: Magacay waa Ana García. Celcelis aan haysayo.
examples.note: Markaad gaadisho hotelka, sheeg magacaaga iyo inaad celcelis haysid. 'Reservation' waa eray oo la mid ah Soomaaliga.

examples.original: I need to cancel my reservation.
examples.translation: Waxaan u baahan yahay inaan fuusho celceliskii.
examples.note: Isticmaali 'need to' + fiilka inaad sheegtid u baahan yahay. 'Cancel' waa la mid ah Soomaaliga.

examples.original: How much is it per night?
examples.note: Isticmaali 'How much' inaad weydii qiimaha. 'Per night' wuxuu yahay 'habeenka'.

examples.original: Does the price include breakfast?
examples.note: Shakhsiyaas, waxaan isticmaamo 'Does' inaan weydii. 'Include' waa la mid ah 'ku soo baxay' Soomaaliga.

examples.original: Is Wi-Fi free?
examples.note: Af-Ingiriisii, 'is' wuxuu u horreysaa shakhsi su'aalaha. 'Free' wuxuu yahay 'bilaash ah' ama 'xuquuq'.

examples.original: What time is check-out?
examples.note: Check-out waa wakhtiga baxaynta, check-in waa wakhtiga galaynta. Waxaa la isticmaalaa magacyo.

title: At the Bank or Exchange Office / Bankiga ama Kanadka Lacagta
bridge: Ingiriisi, inaad u codsan doonto u jeedsan wax, ayaa lagu isticmaalaa 'I would like...' ama 'Can I...?', waxaana u dhexeeyaa inay isku leh 'Quisiera...' ama '¿Me da...?'. Waxaad si buux u fiirsan doontaa inay Ingiriisi ku dhacdo inay qaybaha 'can' iyo 'would' u dhexeeyaan qaybaha aasaasiga ah ee qaybta, 'to' maya, oo kala duwan yahay xanuunka 'some' ama 'any' oo ku salaysan qoraalka oo aan qoraalkan ku jirin, ama su'aasha. Ingiriisi, lacagaha iyo lacagta waxay u qoran yihiin sidii ay u dhexeeyaan: '100 dollars' waxaa lagu qoraa 'one hundred dollars', oo kuwa ku salaysan qoraalka waxay u qoran yihiin shaydhaysa.
rule: Bankiga ama kanadka lacagta si ay u sameeyaan lacagta, waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad isticmaalato qaybaha 'I would like' (aan jeclaan) oo ku dhexeeyaa magaca ama 'to' + qaybta aasaasiga ah. Misaal: 'I would like to exchange dollars' (Waxaan jeclaan inaan beddelo dalaroo). 'Can I...?' (Ma ayay iigu qalin doontaa...?) waxaa lagu isticmaalaa inay u yimaadaan iibka, sida 'Can I open an account?' (Ma ayay iigu qalin doontaa inaan furo xisaab?). Inaad su'aashada beddelka, waxaad dhahdaa 'What is the exchange rate?' (Waxaa lacagta bedelka?). Xusuuso inay Ingiriisi ku jiraan qaybaha aasaasiga ah ee qaybta iyo qaybaha aan qaybta ahayn oo ay ku salaysan yihiin isticmaalka 'some' (oo aan qoraalkan ku jirin) iyo 'any' (oo aan qoraalkan ku jirin). Waxaa muhiim inay u dhexeeyaan qaybaha: su'aashada, qaybta ama qaybta waxaa laga yaabaa inay u dhexeeyaan qaybta.

concept_examples.text: I would like to exchange some dollars.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan inaan beddelo dalaroo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ sʌm ˈdɑːlərz/

concept_examples.text: What is the exchange rate?
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa lacagta bedelka?

concept_examples.text: Can I open a bank account?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayay iigu qalin doontaa inaan furo xisaab banki?

concept_examples.text: I need to withdraw some money.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u baahan yahay inaan soo bixiyo lacag.

common_error.correct_alt: I would like to change money.
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga waxay nuugu dhahantaa 'quiero cambiar dinero' oo aan qaybta ahayn, laakiin Ingiriisi, qaybaha 'want' iyo 'would like' waxay u baahan yihiin qaybta 'to' oo qaybta aasaasiga ah ay u dhexeeyaan qaybta aasaasiga ah. Haddaba waxaad dhahdaa 'I want to change...' ama 'I would like to change...'. Khilaafad u dhexeeyaa inay u dhexeeyaan 'to' oo ay u dhexeeyaan 'want', waxaana u dhexeeyaa inay u dhexeeyaan 'to' oo ay u dhexeeyaan qaybta aasaasiga ah iyo qaybta aasaasiga ah.

examples.original: I would like to exchange euros for pounds.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˈjʊərəʊz fɔː paʊndz/
examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan inaan beddelo euro oo ah pound.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'for' si ay u soo galin lacagta aad doonaysid.

examples.original: What is the rate for dollars?
examples.note: Su'aashada beddelka isticmaal 'rate'.

examples.original: Can I have some small bills?
examples.translation: Ma ayay i siin doontaa lacag yar?
examples.note: 'Small bills' waxay u qaataan lacag yar.

examples.original: Is there a commission?
examples.note: Ingiriisi, su'aashada isticmaal 'Is there...?' oo ah singular.

examples.original: I want to deposit this check into my account.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tuː dɪˈpɒzɪt ðɪs tʃek ˈɪntuː maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Waxaan doonayaa inaan soo galo shahaadkan xisaabtayda.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'into my account' si ay u soo galin meeshii lacagta.

examples.original: Can you withdraw money from my account?
examples.phonetic: /kæn juː wɪðˈdrɔː ˈmʌni frɒm maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Ma ayay ka soo bixin doontaa lacag xisaabtayda?
examples.note: 'Withdraw from' waxay u qaataan qaybta.

examples.original: How much is the service fee?
examples.note: Su'aashada kharashada isticmaal 'How much'.

examples.original: My account number is 12345.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbər ɪz wʌn tuː θriː fɔː faɪv/
examples.note: Ingiriisi, lambarka waxay u qoran yihiin lambar ama lambar.

examples.original: I need to transfer money online.
examples.translation: Waxaan u baahan yahay inaan soo diro lacag internetka.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'online' si ay u soo galin shaqo internetka.

examples.original: This is a currency exchange form.
examples.note: 'Currency' waxay u qaataan lacagta bulshada.

title: Job Interview Basics / Waxbarashada shaqaalaha
bridge: Waxbarashada shaqaalaha ee Ingiriisi, su'aalaha waxay noqon kartaa toos iyo qalab. Waxaad ka faran tahay af-Soomaaliga, 'you' waa la isticmaalayaa si rasmi ah iyo aan rasmi ahayn; waxa ana ku hadalno waa 'you'. Si kastabaaha waxaa la isticmaalayaa mudada hadda ugu dambeeyey in la hadlo saluunaanta iyo mudada dhexdhexaad ah in la hadlo tijaabada shaqaalaha. Fiirso isticmaalka 'do/does' si aad u su'aalo, waxaana lagu sameeyaa in ay noqotoon tahay ama '¿'.
rule: In aad hadashid, isticmaal 'I am' (aan ahay/aan joogaa) iyo 'I have' (aan hayo). In aad sheegi waxaad samaynaysaa, isticmaal mudada hadda ugu dambeeyey: 'I work as...' (waxaan shaqeynayaa sidii...). In aad hadashid tijaabada hore, isticmaal mudada dhexdhexaad ah: 'I worked at...' (waxaan shaqaynayay...). Su'aalaha caadiga ah waxay ku jiraan: 'What do you do?' (Maxaad samaysaa?), 'Why do you want this job?' (Maxaad doonaysaa shaqaalahan?), 'What are your strengths?' (Maxaad tahay nuuriyadaada?). Xusuuso in Ingiriisi ma aha in la fogeeyo isaga.

concept_examples.text: I am a student.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan ahay arday.

concept_examples.text: I have experience in customer service.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan hayo tijaabo xirfadda macmiilka.

concept_examples.text: I worked at a restaurant.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan shaqaynayay guri cunto.

concept_examples.text: Why do you want this job?
concept_examples.translation: Maxaad doonaysaa shaqaalahan?

common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga waxay nuugutaa 'aan hayo 25 sano', laakiin Ingiriisi mudada 'to be' (in ay noqotoon tahay/in ay joogto tahay) ayaa la isticmaalayaa in la sheego jirka, aan isticmaalno 'have' (in la hayo). Ka tiraa tarjumaadda xagga leh.

examples.original: My name is Ana.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'my name is' inaad qayb gal si rasmi ah.

examples.original: I am from Mexico.
examples.note: 'From' ayaa la isticmaalayaa in la soo jeedo meeshii lagu soo baxay.

examples.original: I live in Madrid.
examples.note: Isticmaal mudada hadda ugu dambeeyey inaad sheegi waxaad joogtaa.

examples.original: I can speak English.
examples.note: 'Can' ayaa sheegi saluun, ma aha 'sé' sidii af-Soomaaliga.

examples.original: I am good at computers.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'good at' + ismamaahiisa ama fiilka -ing.

examples.original: I know how to use Excel.
examples.translation: Waxaan ogahay sidii loo isticmaalayo Excel.
examples.note: Qalabka 'know how to' + fiilka.

examples.original: What are your strengths?
examples.note: Su'aal caadi ahaan, jaabto 'I am...' ama 'I can...'.

examples.original: Why do you want this job?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'because' inaad sii sheegto sababaha.

examples.original: I work well in a team.
examples.note: Sheegi khasaarrada adiga oo aad isticmaalato adverbi.

title: At the post office / Booska bukaanka
bridge: Ingiriisi, inoo sheegayaa waxyaabaha iibka iyo codsiyada xogta bukaanka, qoraallada modal ayaa la isticmaalaa 'I need to' ama 'I'd like to', halqaduna Af-Soomaaliga 'u baahan tahay' ama 'rabbaday'. Si kastaba ha ahaadee, Ingiriisi, qoraalka 'send' ayaa la isticmaalaa ilaa shiine 'to' si loo sheego meeshii la soo dirayo (dir qoraal u saddexee qof), halqaduna Af-Soomaaliga 'u dir qoraal u saddexee qof'. Fiir oo fiirsi xilli qoraalka soo galayaasha oo 'How much does it cost?', kuwaasoo Af-Soomaaliga 'Waxay ku qaadanay?'.
rule: Ingiriisi, si taan u hadashid xogta bukaanka iyo adeegyada soo diraya ee darajad A2, isticmaal qoraalladaas: 1) 'I need to + fiil' (baahan tahay + fiil) si aad u sheegto baahan, m. 'I need to send this package.' 2) 'I'd like to + fiil' (rabbaday + fiil) si aad u codsato codsiyada adag, m. 'I'd like to buy some stamps.' 3) 'How much is/are...?' iyo 'How much does it cost?' si aad u weyshiiso qiimaha, m. 'How much is the shipping?' 4) Isticmaal 'to' ilaa shiine fiilaskuu 'send' iyo 'mail' si aad u sheegto qofka la soo dirayo, m. 'Send it to my friend.' 5) Soo galayaasha 'where' iyo 'when' si aad u heli doonaa xogta adeegyada, m. 'Where can I pick up my package?' Xusuuso in Ingiriisi, noocadka ayay u horaysaa magaca (registered mail), halqaduna Af-Soomaaliga waxay u raaxaysaa dambe (bukaanka eachbaday).

concept_examples.text: I need to send a letter to Spain.
concept_examples.translation: Baahan tahay inaan u diro warqad u saddexee Ispanyaan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛnd ə ˈlɛtər tə speɪn/

concept_examples.text: How much does this package cost to ship?
concept_examples.translation: Waxay ku qaadanayaa inaan u diro sanduuqa?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ kɒst tə ʃɪp/

concept_examples.text: I'd like to buy some stamps, please.
concept_examples.translation: Rabbaday inaan iibso calaamad, fadlan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə baɪ sʌm stæmps pliːz/

concept_examples.text: Where can I track my package?
concept_examples.translation: Meel walba ayaan ka heli karaa sanduuqayga?

common_error.correct: How much does the shipping cost?
common_error.explanation: Khalaadkaan waxay noqotay maxaa yeelay Af-Soomaaliga waxaynu weyshiinaynaa 'Waxay ku qaadanay?', laakiin Ingiriisi, soo galayaashuu 'cost' waxay u baahan yihiin 'does' iyo fiilka xilli aasaasiga. 'Costs' ma ayuu leeyahay ilaa shiine 'does'. Kala duwan, isticmaal 'is' meesha 'cost'.

levels.label: Basic needs at the post office

examples.original: I need to buy some stamps.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'need to' si aad u sheegto baahan. 'Stamps' waxay tusaale yihiin calaamad.

examples.original: I'd like to send this package.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'I'd like to' si aad u adag tahay. 'Package' waxay tusaale yihiin sanduuqa.

examples.original: Where is the post office?
examples.translation: Meel walba ayuu joogaa booska bukaanka?
examples.note: Soo galayaasha 'where' iyo fiilka 'to be'.

examples.original: How much is the shipping to Mexico?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ tə ˈmɛksɪkoʊ/
examples.translation: Waxay ku qaadanay inuu u diray Mexico?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'How much is' si aad u weyshiiso qiimaha.

examples.original: I need to send this by registered mail.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛnd ðɪs baɪ ˈrɛdʒɪstərd meɪl/
examples.translation: Baahan tahay inaan u diro kan eachbaday bukaanka.
examples.note: 'Registered mail' waxay tusaale yihiin bukaanka eachbaday. Noocadka ayay u horaysaa magaca.

examples.original: Can I track my package online?
examples.translation: Ma aan ka heli karaa sanduuqayga online?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'can' si aad u weyshiiso haddii ayuusan tahay.

examples.original: I want to send this box to my friend in Colombia.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə sɛnd ðɪs bɒks tə maɪ frɛnd ɪn kəˈlɒmbiə/
examples.translation: Rabbaday inaan u diro sanduuqa u saddexee saaxiibtay Colombia.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'to' si aad u sheegto qofka la soo dirayo iyo 'in' si aad u sheegto dalka.

examples.original: This package is too big for the mailbox.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ ɪz tuː bɪg fɔr ðə ˈmeɪlbɒks/
examples.translation: Sanduuqaan waxay weyn tahay inay u soo galo qalabka bukaanka.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'too + nooc' si aad u sheegto badan.

examples.original: What is the delivery time to the United States?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə dɪˈlɪvəri taɪm tə ðə juˈnaɪtɪd steɪts/
examples.translation: Waxay ka qaadanay inuu u soo galo Merka?
examples.note: Soo galayaasha 'what' si aad u heli doonaa xogta eachbaday.

title: Renting a Flat / Shidaay qaaddashada
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, inoo kaxan gelin qaaddashada waxaynu isticmaalaa 'qaaddashada' ama 'qaaddashada', oo inoo sheegay in qaybta qaaddashada ay tahay 'ay qaadi doonaan' ama 'ay qaadi doonaan'. Ingiriisi, waxaynu isticmaalaa 'qaaddashada' ilaa iibka iibka ('qaaddashada' = qaaddashada), oo 'qaaliyeya' ama 'qaaddashada' inay soo baxaan qaaddashada. Fiirso preposition: Ingiriisi waxay leeyihiin 'qaaddashada qaybta' (ilaa preposition), markaas oo iska ilaalin inay iska yihin 'qaaddashada qaybta'. Had iyo jeer, Ingiriisi, eachalada waxay isticmaalaan 'is for rent' ama 'is available', waxaas oo ah 'ay qaadi doonaan' ama 'ay qaadi doonaan'.
rule: Qaaddashada Ingiriisi A2, waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaatid: (1) Iibka 'to rent' (qaaddashada) iyo sawirradayda: qaaddashada / qaaddashada / qaaddashada / qaaddashada. (2) Preposition 'for' inoo la jiray iibka 'qaaddashada' inay soo baxaan qaaddashada: 'for rent' (qaaddashada). (3) Adjective 'available' (qaaliyeya) inay soo baxaan qaybta qaaddashada. (4) Vocabulary key: 'apartment' (qaaddashada / qaaddashada), 'flat' (qaaddashada, inoo badan oo ay noqoto Ingiriisi British), 'landlord' (qaaddashada / qaaddashada), 'tenant' (qaaddashada), 'deposit' (qaaddashada / qaaddashada), 'qaaddashada' (qaaddashada bisha), 'lease' (qaaddashada qaaddashada). (5) Inoo dhageysto xaaladda, isticmaal 'How much is the rent?' (Qiyaastii qaaddashada waa maxay?) oo 'Is it furnished?' (Ma ay qaadi doonaan?). Xaaladda, xusuuso in Ingiriisi adjectives ay yimaadaan iibka: 'a small apartment', 'an apartment small'.

concept_examples.text: I want to rent an apartment near the city center.
concept_examples.translation: Waan rabnaa inaan qaado qaybta qaaddashada ee dhowrsan magaalada.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tə rent ən əˈpɑːrtmənt nɪr ðə ˈsɪti ˈsɛntər/

concept_examples.text: How much is the rent per month?
concept_examples.translation: Qiyaastii qaaddashada bisha waa maxay?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə rɛnt pər mʌnθ/

concept_examples.text: The apartment is available for rent.
concept_examples.translation: Qaybta qaaddashada ay qaaliyeya inay qaadi doonaan.

concept_examples.text: The landlord requires a deposit of one month's rent.
concept_examples.translation: Qaaddashada wuxuu codsanayaa qaaddashada bisha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈlændlɔrd rɪˈkwaɪərz ə dɪˈpɑzɪt əv wʌn mʌnθs rɛnt/

common_error.wrong: I need to rent a flat for center.
common_error.correct: I need to rent a flat near the center.
common_error.correct_alt: I need to rent a flat in the city center.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadada caadiga ah waxay isticmaalayaan 'for' 'near' ama 'in' inay soo baxaan goobta. Af-Soomaaliga waxaynu leynahay 'for the center' ama 'by the center', laakiin Ingiriisi, 'for' waxay isticmaalayaan qaybta ama faa'iida, aan u ahayn goobta. Inoo dhageysto goobta waxaynu isticmaalaa 'near' (dhowrsan) ama 'in the city center' (magaalada). Ka baxsan preposition 'by' ama 'for'.

examples.original: apartment
examples.note: Ingiriisi American waxay isticmaalayaan 'apartment'; Ingiriisi British waxay isticmaalayaan 'flat'. Labaduba waxay sahlan yihiin.

examples.original: rent (noun)
examples.note: Iibka, 'rent' waxay u cadaynayaan lacagta aad bisha u bixisa. Ha iska ilaalin iibka 'rent' (qaaddashada).

examples.original: landlord
examples.note: Ingiriisi, qaabka dumarka waxay tahay 'landlady', laakiin 'landlord' waxay isticmaalayaan labaduba.

examples.original: deposit
examples.note: Waxay tahay lacagta aad u bixisa si ay u noqoto qaaddashada. Aad u badan waxay ku celin doontaa haddii aan jirto dhibaato.

examples.original: How many bedrooms does the apartment have?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɛdrumz dʌz ðə əˈpɑːrtmənt hæv/
examples.note: Xusuuso in Ingiriisi su'aalaha 'how many' waxay isticmaalayaan inay soo baxaan 'bedrooms'.

examples.original: Is the rent included in the price?
examples.phonetic: /ɪz ðə rɛnt ɪnˈkludɪd ɪn ðə praɪs/
examples.note: Halkan 'rent' waxay u cadaynayaan qaaddashada bisha, oo 'price' waxay noqon doontaa qiimihii guud ama qiimihii ugu horeeya.

examples.original: When can I move in?
examples.translation: Goormaan u baahnay inaan u baxdo?
examples.note: Tusaale 'move in' waxay u cadaynayaan 'u baxdo goobta cusub'.

examples.original: The apartment is furnished, but the kitchen is small.
examples.phonetic: /ðə əˈpɑːrtmənt ɪz ˈfɜːrnɪʃt bʌt ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɪz smɔl/
examples.translation: Qaybta qaaddashada ay qaaliyeya, laakiin jikada ay qaaliyeya.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'but' (laakiin) inaad soo baxan xaaladaha aan la mid ahayn.

examples.original: Can you lower the rent?
examples.note: Iibka 'lower' waxay u cadaynayaan 'u qaadi doonaa', xaaladaha qiimaha ama tirada.

examples.original: I'd like to sign a lease for one year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə saɪn ə lis fɔr wʌn jɪr/
examples.translation: Waan rabnaa inaan qaado qaaddashada sano.
examples.note: Qalad 'I'd like' waxay u cadaynayaan 'I would like', oo Af-Soomaaliga waxay noqon doontaa 'waan rabnaa'.

title: Making small talk at a party / Haddii aad ku hadashid shir
bridge: Faransiis, markii aad galaan shir, waxaan ku waydhiyaa 'Sidee bahay?' ama 'Sidee tahay?' waxaana aannu u isticmaali noo 'jooga' inay noqoto xaalad dawlada ah. Ingiriisi, waxaan u isticmaali noo 'Sidee bahay?' laakiin hadalad oo kale oo 'Sidee bahay?' ama 'Maxaa u egay?' oo ayaa mid ka mid ah sii dawlada ah. Xusuuso in Ingiriisi ma ayayaan isticmaalaya 'Waxaan kuu raalli gelayaa' si adag oo 'Waxaan ku raalli gelayaa' (qalad caan ah), laakiin 'Waxaan ku raalli gelayaa'. Si toos ah, jawaabta 'Sidee bahay?' waxay ku dhacaysa inay noqoto qallafsan oo qumman, sida 'Waxaan fiican ahay, mahadsanid', in kastoo ma aha mid nolosha ah, kala duwan oo ay tahay su'aasha inay sii badan u soo baxaan faransiiska.
rule: Inuu ku hadashid shir, isticmaal kalamadda aan xumaysanayn oo 'Hey, sidee bahay?' ama 'Maxaa u egay?' (jawaabta: 'Ma jiro wax badan, adiga?'). Inuu soo magacaabin, dhah 'Waxaan ahay [magaca], wanaagsan inaan kuula socdo'. Inuu soo bixiso qof, isticmaal 'Ma ayad u jeclaan tahay inaad cabbito?' (qalab weyn) ama 'Ma ayad u jeclaan tahay inaad cabbito?' (si adag oo si adag). Inuu hadlo jeclo, isticmaal 'Waxaan jeclaa...' / 'Ma jeclaan...'. Inuu soo bixiso raalli gelin, xusuuso in erayga wuxuu yahay 'raalli gelin' (ma 'jooga raalli gelin'): 'Waxaan ku raalli gelayaa'. Jawaabta 'Sidee bahay?' waxay ku dhacaysa inay noqoto qumman: 'Waxaan fiican ahay', 'Waxaan fiican ahay', 'Fiican u dhexeeyey'. Inuu fogaan, isticmaal 'Waa ayay inaan ku hadalno' ama 'Nala joog ilaa dabadeed'.

concept_examples.text: Hi, I'm Maria. Nice to meet you.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aad, waxaan ahay Marya. Wanaagsan inaan kuula socdo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm məˈriːə naɪs tə miːt juː/

concept_examples.text: How's it going?
concept_examples.translation: Sidee kuu egay?

concept_examples.text: Would you like something to drink?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad u jeclaan tahay inaad cabbito?

concept_examples.text: I agree with you, this party is great.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan ku raalli gelayaa, shirkan waa u adag.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ əˈɡriː wɪð juː ðɪs ˈpɑːrti ɪz ɡreɪt/

common_error.explanation: Qaladku wuxuu ka yimid tarjamaadka si adag oo 'waxaan ku raalli gelayaa' isticmaalaya erayga 'jooga' (jooga). Ingiriisi, 'raalli gelin' waa eray oo buuxsamay, ma aha mid aad u adag, sidaas daraaddeed ma ayayaan isticmaalaya 'jooga'. Inuu cadaadiso, xusuuso in 'raalli gelin' wuxuu kadimaynaa erayga 'do' negations iyo su'aalo: 'Ma aan raalli gelin', 'Ma ayad raalli gelin'?

examples.original: Hey, I'm John. What's your name?
examples.translation: Haddii aad, waxaan ahay John. Magacaa huu?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'Magacaa huu?' inuu waydhiiso magaca, laakiin waa si aan u adag oo aan u adag ah inuu isticmaalo 'Magacaa huu?' si aan u adag ah.

examples.original: Nice to meet you, too.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'too' ugu dambeynta inuu soo baxayo salamaa.

examples.original: This is my friend, Ana.
examples.note: Soo magacaabin, 'Kanu waa...' waa mid ka mid ah inuu soo magacaabin qof kale.

examples.original: Can I get you a drink?
examples.translation: Ma ayad u jeclaan tahay inaan ku keenyo cabbito?
examples.note: 'Can I...' waa aan xumaysanayn oo aan xumaysanayn ah. 'May I...' waa si fiican oo si fiican ah.

examples.original: Would you like some snacks?
examples.translation: Ma ayad u jeclaan tahay inaad cabbito?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'some' bixinta, ma 'any'.

examples.original: Could you pass me the chips, please?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː pæs miː ðə tʃɪps pliːz/
examples.translation: Ma ayad u jeclaan tahay inaad i siisay dhexdhexaad, fadlan?
examples.note: 'Could' waa si fiican oo si fiican ah inuu weydhiiso xanaaq.

examples.original: Wow, this is fun!
examples.note: Isticmaal 'Wow' inuu soo baxayo xushaddii.

examples.original: I really like this music.
examples.note: Geli 'really' ugu horreysa erayga inuu soo baxayo xushaddii.

examples.original: It was nice talking to you. See you later!
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz naɪs ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə juː siː juː ˈleɪtər/
examples.translation: Waa ayay inaan ku hadalno. Ilaa dabadeed!
examples.note: Inuu fogaan, isticmaal 'Waa ayay inaan ku hadalno' ka dibna 'Nala joog ilaa dabadeed' sida fogaan aan xumaysanayn ah.

examples.original: I have to go now. Thanks for having me!
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tə ɡoʊ naʊ θæŋks fər hævɪŋ miː/
examples.translation: Waxaan u baahan yahay inaan tashan haatka. Mahadsanid inaad i deyday!
examples.note: Mahadsanid ugaadhka 'Mahadsanid inaad i deyday'.

title: Complaining and Apologizing / Shaki iyo u adeegsanaya
bridge: Faransiiska, adigoo u adeegsanaya waxaad aman tahay 'lo siento' ama 'perdón', laakiin Ingiriishiisu wuxuu leeyahay faas: 'I'm sorry' waxaa la isticmaalaa wax xumahood ama shaqsiyahood u badan, halmarintii 'excuse me' waxaa la isticmaalaa in la ogaado ama u adeegsanaya wax yar. Si aad u badan baa Ingiriishiisu u isticmaalaa muddada hadda 'can't' ama 'won't' inuu u sheego xumaan, halmarintii Faransiisku waxaad tidhaahdin lahaa 'no puedo' ama 'no quiere' si tashiif ah. Fiirso suuradda erayada iyo isticmaalka 'to' erayada oo kala duwan 'sorry'.
rule: Inaad shaki, waxaad isticmaali kartaa xukummo 'I can't + fiil' (ma samayn karo) ama 'This is + nooc' (kan waa + nooc). Inaad u adeegsanayso, isticmaali 'I'm sorry (for) + gerund' ama 'I apologize for + magaca'. Xusuuso in 'sorry' wuxuu raacayaa 'for' markaad soo sheegtid sababta (I'm sorry for being late). Halmaaqa rasmi ah, 'I apologize' waa inuu u sii rasmi ah. Inaad qaaddo u adeegsanaya, waxaad odhan kartaa 'It's okay', 'No problem', ama 'That's fine'. Ha isticmaali 'I'm sorry' inaad ogolaanshaha codsato (isticmaali 'excuse me').

concept_examples.text: I'm sorry for being late.
concept_examples.translation: Waan ka xumahay inaan dhinacyadaada soo gaadhay.

concept_examples.text: This is really annoying.
concept_examples.translation: Kan waa wax xun.

concept_examples.text: I can't find my keys.
concept_examples.translation: Ma helin dukaanadii.

concept_examples.text: Excuse me, could you help me?
concept_examples.translation: Na soo ogolaadaa, ma iiga qalad gali?

common_error.wrong: I am sorry, but I have a problem.
common_error.correct: I'm sorry, but I have a problem.
common_error.correct_alt: Excuse me, I have a problem.
common_error.explanation: Ingiriishiiska amaansan, qaldabka 'I'm' waxay sii aman tahay 'I am' dhibaatooyinka. Isticmaalka 'I am' waxay ku qallafsan tahay si rasmi ah. Si aad u badan baa kuwa afka Faransiisku ku hadla 'I am sorry' ay isticmaalaan halmaaqa ay u adeegsanayaan, laakiin Ingiriishiisu waxaa la isticmaalaa 'excuse me' in la ogaado ilaa ay ku shakaan.

examples.original: I'm sorry.
examples.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa u adeegsanaya xumaanta. Faransiisku, 'lo siento' waxay aman tahay, laakiin Ingiriishiisu waxaa sii aman tahay.

examples.original: I apologize.
examples.note: Waa inuu u sii rasmi ah 'I'm sorry'. Isticmaali halmaaqa xumahood u badan ama dad aan adagayn.

examples.original: Sorry about that.
examples.note: Amaansan iyo qaansan. Waxaa la isticmaalaa saaxiibbada ama halmaaqa adag.

examples.original: I can't stand the noise.
examples.note: 'Can't stand' waa hadal xoog badan oo u sheegaya curad. Faransiisku waxaad tidhaahdin lahaa 'no soporto', oo kale.

examples.original: This is not what I ordered.
examples.note: Waxaa ku fidisan yahay dukaamadas ama dukaamadas. Isticmaali muddada dabeecad 'ordered' inaad soo sheegtid codsigaaga.

examples.original: The service is too slow.
examples.note: 'Too + nooc' wuxuu tusaale ahaan yahay 'si badan', oo kale 'demasiado' Faransiisku.

examples.original: I've been waiting for an hour.
examples.note: Isticmaali muddada hadda oo dambe inaad u sheegto halmaaqa aan dhammayn. Faransiisku waxaad tidhaahdin lahaa 'llevo esperando una hora'.

examples.original: It's okay.
examples.note: Jawaab amaansan oo qaadanaya u adeegsanaya. Faransiisku waxaad odhan kartaa 'está bien' ama 'no pasa nada'.

examples.original: No problem.
examples.note: Si badan oo kale Ingiriishiiska Amerikanka. Waxay u eg tahay 'no hay problema' Faransiisku.

examples.original: That's all right.
examples.note: kala duwan 'waa fiican', laakiin waa inuu u sii rasmi ah. Faransiisku, 'no importa' waa la mid ah.

examples.original: Don't worry about it.
examples.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa in la dhiibiyo qofka u adeegsanaya. Waxay u eg tahay 'no te preocupes' Faransiisku.

title: Describing your hometown / Magacaaga ama magaaladaada
bridge: Ingiriisi, inoo sheegtaa magacaaga ama magaaladaada, aad isticmaashaa fiilka 'to be' si aad sheegto sidee ay tahay (weyn, yar, qiimo leh) oo aad isticmaashaa 'there is/there are' si aad sheegto goobaha. Af-Soomaaliga, aad dhahdaa 'waxay weyn tahay' ama 'waxaa jira beer', laakiin Ingiriisi xusuuso in 'there is' waa u dhexeeya singular oo 'there are' waa u dhexeeya plural. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, mijaajiska erayada waa mid aan u hubin: ugu horreysa sujalka oo dabadeedna fiilku, sida 'My city is big'. Ardayada af-Soomaali aad baan u araggo inay marayo inay isticmaalaan 'there is/are' ama inay soo baxaan adjective ka dib markii noun, sida 'the city big' malaa 'the big city'.
rule:
Si aad u sheegto magacaaga ama magaaladaada Ingiriisi deggan A2, isticmaala mijaajiskaas:

1. **Sujal + fiilka 'to be' (am/is/are) + adjective**: Sheeg cimooyinka guud. Misal: 'My town is small.' (Magaaladii waa yar).
   - Pronouns: I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, they are.
   - Adjectives baa u horreysaa noun markii ay u xad gudbeyn: 'a big city', malaa 'a city big'.

2. **There is / There are**: Si aad sheegto in wax jira magacaaga.
   - There is + noun singular/countable aan la sheegin: 'There is a park.' (Waxaa jira beer).
   - There are + noun plural: 'There are two schools.' (Laba xoolo waxay jiraan).
   - Diidmo: There isn't / There aren't: 'There isn't a cinema.' (Cinema ma jiro).
   - Su'aalo: Is there...? Are there...? (Miyey jiraan...?).

3. **Prepositions of place**: Si aad sheegto meeshii goobaha.
   - 'in the center' (dhexdhexaad), 'on the corner' (kooxda), 'near' (laga yaale), 'next to' (lada-gal).

4. **Action verbs**: 'You can see', 'you can find', 'there is' ayna isticmaalayaan inay sheegaan 'lagu helay'.

5. **Connectors**: Isticmaala 'and' si aad u soo xidhiso fikrad iyo 'but' si aad u soo xidhiso isku-xishood: 'My town is small but beautiful.' (Magaaladii waa yar laakiin wanaagsan).

A2, qor jawaan oo toos ah. Xusuuso in plural 'there is' waa 'there are' – ha dhahdin 'there is many shops'.

concept_examples.text: My city is big and modern.
concept_examples.translation: Magaaladii waa weyn oo modern.

concept_examples.text: There is a beautiful park in the center.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa jira beer wanaagsan dhexdhexaad.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə ˈbjuːtɪfʊl pɑːrk ɪn ðə ˈsentər/

concept_examples.text: There are two small shops near my house.
concept_examples.translation: Laba dukaan yar waxay jiraan gurigii aan galay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː tuː smɔːl ʃɒps nɪər maɪ haʊs/

concept_examples.text: My town is quiet, but it's very friendly.
concept_examples.translation: Magaaladii waa damacsan, laakiin waa mid wanaagsan/dhaw.
concept_examples.phonetic: /maɪ taʊn ɪz ˈkwaɪət bʌt ɪts ˈveri ˈfrendli/

common_error.correct_alt: There is a church in my town.
common_error.explanation: Khalaad weyn waa in la isticmaalo 'have' third person singular (he/she/it). Ingiriisi, 'town' (it) aad rabta inaad isticmaashaa 'has'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ardayada aad baan u araggo inay furan 'there is' oo ay isticmaalaan 'have' sida af-Soomaali 'magaaladii waa lahaa masiid'. Ingiriisi, inoo sheegtaa wax jira, waa inaan isticmaalo 'there is' ka badan 'to have'.

examples.original: My city is very big.
examples.translation: Magaaladii waa weyn aad u weyn.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'very' si aad u adagto adjective, sida 'aad u weyn' af-Soomaali.

examples.original: It is small and quiet.
examples.note: Xusuuso in 'quiet' wuxuu mean qof damacsan (aan suurto ahayn), malaa 'quite' (aad u).

examples.original: The city is busy in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪti ɪz ˈbɪzi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
examples.note: Ingiriisi, inoo sheegtaa cimooyin dhaqan ah, aan isticmaalo 'is', laakiin 'busy' ayuu u ahay cimo temporary; halkan wuxuu u jirtaa cimo dhaqan ah.

levels.label: Describing places with 'there is' and 'there are'

examples.original: There is a museum and a library.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə mjuːˈziːəm ænd ə ˈlaɪbrəri/
examples.note: Markii aad soo baxdo wax yar, isticmaala 'there is' ugu horreysa ama haddii ay ahayd wax aan la tirin, laakiin plural aad isticmaashaa 'there are'.

examples.original: There are many restaurants in the main square.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː ˈmeni ˈrestərɒnts ɪn ðə meɪn skweər/
examples.translation: Waxaa jira dukaan badan meeshii ugu weyn.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'many' plural countable, sida 'dukaan badan'.

examples.original: Is there a supermarket near here?
examples.translation: Miyey jiraan supermarket laga yaale halkan?
examples.note: Su'aalo, beddel: 'Is there...?'

examples.original: There aren't any museums in my town.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni mjuːˈziːəmz ɪn maɪ taʊn/
examples.note: Isticmaala 'aren't any' si aad diidmo plural; 'there isn't' singular.

examples.original: I love my city because it's beautiful.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv maɪ ˈsɪti bɪkəz ɪts ˈbjuːtɪfʊl/
examples.translation: Waan jeclaa magaaladii maxaa yeelay waa wanaagsan.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'because' si aad sheegto sababta, sida 'maxaa yeelay' af-Soomaali.

examples.original: You should visit the old castle.
examples.translation: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad tashi qalaf weyn.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'should' si aad tashil u qaato; af-Soomaali 'waxaad u baahan tahay'.

examples.original: It's a great place to live.
examples.translation: Waa meeshii wanaagsan in la noolaado.
examples.note: 'A great place' wuxuu mean meeshii wanaagsan; isticmaala 'live' (nool) 'in' aan u dhex jirin.

title: Talking About Hobbies / Hadal ka baxay cayaaraha iyo waqtiga u foosan
bridge: Faransiiska, inoo hadlo cayaaraha verb-ku 'gustar' ama 'encantar' waxay u adeegtaa pronoune indirect ('me gusta', 'te gusta'), iyo in badan waxay nuqul la'aan tahay 'me gusta + infinitivo'. Ingiriishi, verb-ka 'like' waxay u adeegtaa si adag oo ka badan: 'I like + -ing' ama 'I like + to + verb'. Kala duwan kale waxay tahay in Ingiriishi ma aynu isticmaalno article-ka maalin-maalin oo ah 'on Mondays' (los lunes), halqad Faransiiska waxay nuqul tahay 'los lunes'. Ingiriishi, waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'do' si aan u waydiiyo cayaaraha ('What do you do in your free time?'), Faransiiska waxay nuqul tahay '¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre?'.
rule: Ingiriishi hadal ka baxay cayaaraha (makiin A2): isticmaala verb-ka 'like', 'love', 'enjoy' ama 'prefer' oo la soo raacay noun ama verb oo ah -ing (misaal 'I like music', 'I love playing soccer'). Isticmaala 'be interested in' + noun ama -ing (misaal 'I'm interested in photography'). Si aad u waydiiso, isticmaala 'What do you like doing?' ama 'What do you do in your free time?'. Si aad u soo bixiso mida, isticmaala adverbs oo leh 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes', 'never' ka hor verb-ka ugu muhiimsan (misaal 'I usually read'). Isticmaala prepositions 'in' (in my free time), 'on' (on weekends, on Mondays) iyo 'at' (at home, at the weekend – Ingiriishi British). Fiir: 'do' ma isticmaali 'like' oo ah present simple si aad u sheegto (waxay nuqul tahay 'I like', 'I do like' haddii aad rabto inaad u cadaysid).

concept_examples.text: I like listening to music.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclahay inaan maqlo muusiko.

concept_examples.text: She loves playing tennis.
concept_examples.translation: Iyada waxay adag tahay inay tixraacdo tennis.

concept_examples.text: What do you do in your free time?
concept_examples.translation: Maxaad samaysaa waqtigaaga u foosan?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt duː juː duː ɪn jɔː friː taɪm/

concept_examples.text: I usually go hiking on weekends.
concept_examples.translation: Kadibad baan u tagayaa safarada munaarada oo ah munaarada.

common_error.explanation: Khalaadkaan waxay noqotaa maxaa yeelay Faransiiska waxay nuqul tahay 'me gusta jugar' isticmaalaya infinitive, iyo ardayda waxay u soo dirtaa qalabkan Ingiriishi. Laakiin, Ingiriishi, ka dib 'like', 'love', 'enjoy' iyadoo ah -ing ama kadib 'to' (laakiin maaha infinitive oo aan 'to' lahayn). Si aad u ilaalato, xusuuso: ka dib 'like', isticmaala qalabka -ing: 'I like playing'. Waxaad isticmaalay 'I like to play', laakiin waa yarayaan.

examples.original: I love reading books.
examples.translation: Waxaan adag tahay inaan akhriso buugag.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'love' + -ing si aad u soo bixiso jeclaan adag. Faransiiska waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'encantar'.

examples.original: She enjoys painting.
examples.translation: Iyada waxay jeclahay inay soo qoriso.
examples.note: 'Enjoy' waxay diimaan la soo raacay -ing. 'Enjoy to paint' ma nuqulayo.

examples.original: I don't like cooking.
examples.note: Si aad u diido, isticmaala 'don't' + like + -ing. Faransiiska: 'no me gusta'.

examples.original: What do you like doing?
examples.note: Tanu waa qalabka ugu adag oo loo isticmaalayo si loo waydiiyo cayaaraha. Faransiiska: '¿Qué te gusta hacer?'

examples.original: Do you play any sports?
examples.note: Isticmaala 'play' la cayaaraha qaybta (play football, play tennis). Faransiiska: 'jugar'.

examples.original: How often do you go to the cinema?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɒfən duː juː ɡəʊ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.translation: Sidee baad u badan tihiin cinema?
examples.note: Faransiiska waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'ir al cine' la 'a'; Ingiriishi waxaynu isticmaalnaa 'go to + meesha'.

examples.original: I often watch TV in the evening.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɒfən wɒtʃ ˌtiːˈviː ɪn ðə ˈiːvnɪŋ/
examples.note: Adverbs mida (often, usually, always) waxay ku noqotaa ka hor verb-ka ugu muhiimsan. Faransiiska waxay nuqul tahay 'a menudo'.

examples.original: I prefer playing video games to reading.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ prɪˈfɜː ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈvɪdiəʊ ɡeɪmz tə ˈriːdɪŋ/
examples.translation: Waxaan jeclahay inaan tixraaco video games ka badan inaan akhristo.
examples.note: Si aad u soo bixiso jeclaan, isticmaala 'prefer A to B', la labaduba -ing. Faransiiska: 'prefiero X a Y'.

examples.original: On Sundays, I usually go for a walk.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn ˈsʌndeɪz aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡəʊ fər ə wɔːk/
examples.translation: Axadka, badanaa baan u tagayaa inaan tago.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'on' la maalmaha toddobaad oo ah. Faransiiska waxay nuqul tahay 'los domingos'.

translations.so: Hadal ka baxay cayaaraha iyo waqtiga u foosan
